problem:
Problem description
- There is a cyclic staffing horizon of length $$H$$, divided into $$T$$ demand intervals indexed by $$t \in \mathcal{T}$$.
- For each interval $$t$$, the restaurant requires at least $$d_t$$ waiters on duty.
- There is a fixed shift length of $$L$$ hours for every waiter.
- Feasible shift starts are indexed by $$s \in \mathcal{S}$$, and a shift may wrap around the end of the cyclic horizon.
- The planning decision is to determine how many waiters should begin at each feasible shift start.
- The optimization goal is to minimize the total number of waiters scheduled while ensuring that every demand interval is covered by enough overlapping shifts.
- The business requirements are: every interval must meet or exceed its minimum staffing requirement; every waiter must work one uninterrupted shift of exactly $$L$$ hours; no waiter is split across multiple shifts within the same day; and the schedule must respect the full cyclic operating horizon.
- A solution is represented by:
  - $$x_s$$: the number of waiters assigned to start at feasible shift start $$s \in \mathcal{S}$$.
  - $$Z$$: the total number of waiters scheduled across all feasible shift starts.

Input Format
{
  "H": "scalar; total cyclic planning horizon length",
  "L": "scalar; fixed continuous shift length for each waiter",
  "T": "integer; number of demand intervals",
  "intervals": [
    {
      "id": "integer index $$t$$",
      "start": "time point $$\\tau_t$$",
      "end": "time point $$\\tau_{t+1}$$",
      "demand": "minimum staffing requirement $$d_t$$"
    }
  ],
  "S": "integer; number of feasible shift-start positions",
  "shift_starts": "array of length $$S$$ containing the candidate shift start times $$s \\in \\mathcal{S}$$",
  "coverage_information": "optional interval-to-shift coverage data describing which feasible shift starts cover each demand interval"
}

Output Format
{
  "x": "array of length $$S$$; $$x_s$$ is the number of waiters assigned to shift start $$s$$",
  "total_waiters": "scalar; the minimum total number of waiters scheduled"
}

Example(s)

Input 1
{
  "H": 24,
  "L": 8,
  "T": 6,
  "intervals": [
    { "id": 1, "start": 2, "end": 6, "demand": 4 },
    { "id": 2, "start": 6, "end": 10, "demand": 8 },
    { "id": 3, "start": 10, "end": 14, "demand": 10 },
    { "id": 4, "start": 14, "end": 18, "demand": 7 },
    { "id": 5, "start": 18, "end": 22, "demand": 12 },
    { "id": 6, "start": 22, "end": 2, "demand": 4 }
  ],
  "shift_starts": [2, 6, 10, 14, 18, 22]
}

parameters.name: shift_length
parameters.description: Fixed shift length for each waiter

parameters.name: interval_start_time
parameters.description: Start time of each demand interval

parameters.name: interval_end_time
parameters.description: End time of each demand interval

parameters.name: min_staffing_requirement
parameters.description: Minimum staffing requirement for each demand interval

parameters.name: feasible_shift_start_indices
parameters.description: Index set of feasible shift starts

parameters.name: shift_start_time
parameters.description: Feasible shift start time for each shift-start position

parameters.name: coverage_indicator
parameters.description: Indicator that a shift starting at s covers demand interval t

variables.name: waiter_starts
variables.description: Number of waiters assigned to start at each feasible shift start

variables.name: total_waiters_scheduled
variables.description: Total number of waiters scheduled across all feasible shift starts

constraints.name: minimum_staffing_coverage
constraints.description: Every demand interval must be staffed at or above its minimum requirement by overlapping shifts

constraints.name: waiter_starts_domain
constraints.description: Each shift-start decision variable is a nonnegative integer count of waiters starting at that shift start

constraints.name: total_waiters_domain
constraints.description: The total scheduled workforce is a nonnegative integer

constraints.name: total_waiters_balance
constraints.description: The total number of scheduled waiters equals the sum of waiters assigned to all feasible shift starts

objectives.name: minimize_total_waiters
objectives.description: Minimize the total number of waiters scheduled across all feasible shift starts

final_objective.description: Minimize the total number of waiters scheduled across all feasible shift starts.
